note: The shared type set's measured advances (D-125). One committed value per role, asserted by writeitdown/qa/typography.spec.mjs in the browser; the Mac keeps the same numbers in apps/macos/FirstLine/design/type-baseline.json for TypographyParityTests through CoreText. The Mac is the reference: its numbers are in points, and the web must agree within 0.05 %, which is far tighter than a face substitution moves an advance (1-9 %) and far looser than OS text-stack updates (measured agreement is 0.005 %).
